_source: Lee et al. 2024, Sci Rep, 'Comparative genomics of six Cladonia species', DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-51895-x. BGC counts via antiSMASH fungal v7.0 (default parameters), Figure 2 / Section 'Prediction of BGCs and CAZymes'.
_notes: Counts apply to clean reference genomes (not metagenomes), so they form a per-species ceiling for what Hyphae's MAGs should approach.
Recovering >= 90 % of these counts on Hyphae's MAGs of the same species means the assembly + binning pathway is competitive with the reference-genome ceiling.
Outperforming means recovering >= 100 % AND more orphans + named-BGC matches when ensembling with DeepBGC/GECCO (deferred to v0.2).
